# Yggdrasil porridge

Type: Food | Internal ID: YggdrasilPorridge | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Sap x4, Barley x3, Royal jelly x2 | Max Health: 27 | Max Stamina: 13 | Max Eitr: 80 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Yggdrasil porridge is a Mistlands-tier food.

## Recipe

Yggdrasil porridge is produced at a level 5 Cauldron with:
• 4 Sap
• 3 Barley
• 2 Royal jelly

### Crafting

• Mushrooms galore á la Mistlands

## Notes

• Yggdrasil porridge provides the second highest eitr gain in the Mistlands at 80, second to Seeker aspic at 85.
• Two pieces of Royal jelly yields two Seeker aspics (a 2:2 ratio of jelly to aspic), whereas two pieces of Royal jelly yield only one Yggdrasil porridge (a 2:1 ratio of jelly to porridge).
